purpose: Materialize deterministic public-safe identities for every eligible AU/AG contract-local-date-cadence unit under the already-frozen liquid-premium rules, without reading or publishing a premium path or outcome.

frozen_boundary.eligibility_rule_source: Apply the bound eligibility contract literally; thresholds, predicates, failure ordering and timestamp semantics may not be changed.
frozen_boundary.post_cutoff_rule: Rows after the unit's inclusive 15:00:00 local cutoff are excluded before every eligibility statistic and cannot affect membership.

data_access_policy.data_root: An explicit caller-supplied root; it is never inferred, searched for, or serialized.
data_access_policy.inventory_enumeration: For each allowed cadence and product, enumerate only direct children of <data_root>/<cadence> matching SHFE.<product>*.parquet, retain only filenames matching the bound identity regex, and bytewise-sort relative POSIX paths.
data_access_policy.inventory_digest_algorithm: sha256 of canonical compact JSON plus LF for the sorted paths relative to data_root, identical to the bound evidence builder

coverage_and_missing_semantics.verified_complete: Observed source-file count and inventory digest equal the bound values, and every expected file is readable with the bound required schema.
coverage_and_missing_semantics.missing_expected_file: The observed count or inventory digest shows an expected path is absent. Abort without writing a membership artifact.
coverage_and_missing_semantics.unexpected_inventory_file: The observed count or inventory digest shows inventory drift. Abort without writing a membership artifact.
coverage_and_missing_semantics.unreadable_expected_file: Any expected file cannot be opened or read. Abort without writing a membership artifact.
coverage_and_missing_semantics.missing_required_schema: Any expected file lacks a column required by the bound eligibility contract. Abort without writing a membership artifact.
coverage_and_missing_semantics.no_rows_in_frozen_window: A verified readable file with no qualifying local date contributes zero units; it is not imputed or substituted.
coverage_and_missing_semantics.ineligible_unit: A present contract-date-cadence unit failing any bound eligibility predicate is omitted from members and counted only in aggregate reconciliation.
coverage_and_missing_semantics.eligible_count_reconciliation: Each product-cadence member count must exactly equal expected_eligible_units; any difference aborts without writing.

membership_output.strike_encoding: Canonical source identity string; numeric ordering uses exact decimal comparison and does not rewrite identity.

required_verification: Verify both bound input bytes before external access.
Verify exact inventory count and digest for every product-cadence partition.
Verify every member passes the unchanged bound eligibility rule using only rows at or before its cutoff.
Verify appending post-cutoff rows cannot change member identities.
Verify missing, extra, unreadable or schema-incompatible expected files fail closed without partial output.
Verify member keys are unique, complete, deterministically ordered and reconcile to all four bound eligible counts.
Verify the public artifact contains only the exact member fields and public-safe aggregate metadata.
limitations: Finalized historical rows may contain later revisions and do not establish contemporaneous operational observability.
Eligibility membership does not expose or evaluate any option price, premium path, outcome or executable quote.
Membership does not select a contract or establish a bare-K or DD-line confirmation.
A faithful authentic machine-testable Feitian bare-K or DD-line rule remains a separate blocker.

promotion.next_gate: Bind this membership artifact with the explicit PA alert corpus, but do not inspect a premium path until an authentic machine-testable bare-K or DD-line definition is recovered and a successor observation contract is frozen.
